founder.heading: Build a week you can follow.
founder.lead: Tools for thinking clearly, choosing one useful action, and reflecting on what happened. Follow my fitness journey as I build {{ brand }} in public.
founder.story_body: I’m Owen. I went from 240 lb to 175 lb and now have visible abs. {{ brand }} is where I’m bringing my interest in clear thinking together with my health and fitness journey.
founder.story_note: This is my personal experience. It is not a promise of someone else’s results.

practice.heading: A simple weekly practice.
practice.choose_body: Name the action you want to make room for this week. Keep it concrete enough to observe.
practice.plan_body: Choose a time and a realistic fallback. Fit the plan around the week you actually have.
practice.review_body: Write down what happened, what got in the way, and one change to try next. Your notes belong to you.

newsletter.label: Stay in the loop
newsletter.heading: Follow the next chapter.
newsletter.description: Get {{ brand }} notes on planning, reflection, new tools, and my fitness journey.
newsletter.consent: By subscribing, you agree to receive {{ brand }} marketing emails. You can unsubscribe at any time. This form collects your email address, not your journal entries.
newsletter.success: Thanks for subscribing. You’re on the {{ brand }} list.
